sn54.7:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākappino bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
sn54.7:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmā mahākappinaṃ avidūre nisinnaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
sn54.7:2.1: “passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, etassa bhikkhuno kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vā”ti
sn54.7:2.2: yadā’pi mayaṃ bhante, taṃ āyasmantaṃ passāma saṅghamajjhe vā nisinnaṃ ekaṃ vā raho nisinnaṃ tadā’pi mayaṃ tassa āyasmato na passāma kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vāti.
sn54.7:3.1: yassa bhikkhave, samādhissa bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā. na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā, tassa so bhikkhave, bhikkhu samādhissa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
sn54.7:3.2: katamassa ca bhikkhave, samādhissa bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā, na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā:
sn54.7:4.1: ānāpānasatisamādhissa bhikkhave, bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā. na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā.
sn54.7:4.2: kathaṃ bhāvite ca bhikkhave, ānāpānasatisamādhimhi kathaṃ bahulīkate neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā, na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā:
sn54.7:5.1: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā
sn54.7:5.4: evaṃ bhāvite kho bhikkhave, ānāpānasatisamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate neva kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vā, na cittassa iñjitattaṃ vā hoti phanditattaṃ vāti.
